summary: Obfuscated remote-agent daemon with WebSocket-driven PTY and SSH tunneling to local RDP/VNC
details: @whalent/agent-core ships a 13.5 MB obfuscator.io-transformed main bundle (dist/index.cjs; ~105k-entry rotated string array, control-flow flattening, _0xNNNN identifiers) that combines node-pty (optionalDependencies), ssh2, and a WebSocket message dispatcher into a remote-controlled shell/agent runtime. The bundle exposes a handleMessage/dispatch router with xterm/onData/cols: fields driving PTY sessions, and references 127.0.0.1:3389, 127.0.0.1:5900, and 127.0.0.1:5901 as SSH port-forward targets — the local RDP and VNC services on the installer's host. Whoever controls the remote WebSocket endpoint gains interactive shell execution and remote-desktop access on the installer's machine. The WebSocket destination host is not present as a plain literal and is reconstructed through the obfuscated string array, hiding the control-plane endpoint from review. The README documents that this package is "replaced by remote daemon upgrades," and the bundle contains no visible pinning, signature, or hash verification of that upgrade payload, so the installed code is subject to arbitrary future replacement by the operator of the control plane.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
